Faculty Pipeline Model

Rank progression, tenure clock, SURS retirement eligibility, separations and hiring for full-time instructional faculty. Annual cohort-component Markov model, 15-year horizon from the Fall 2023 IPEDS snapshot, P10/P50/P90 across Monte Carlo runs.

Public aggregates and synthetic detail only. These are scenarios, not forecasts. The start state matches IPEDS Fall 2023 headcounts exactly. Ages, tiers and years in rank are synthetic. Transition rates come from published literature and from steady-state flow balance on one year of IPEDS hires, not from University records. Use the levers to compare scenarios with each other. Do not read the levels as predictions.

Rank mix trajectory

Stacked P50 headcount by state. Each state's median is computed separately, so the stack can differ from the total's median by a few people. The total band is in the next chart.

Retirement wave

Retirements P50P10–P90 whisker

Annual retirements, all states. The incentive multiplies the hazard for SURS-eligible faculty in years 1–2 and pulls retirements forward. Over 15 years it mostly changes timing, not the total.

SURS-eligible headcount

P10–P90Scenario P50Baseline P50

Faculty eligible to retire at each Fall census under a simplified rule: Tier 1 from age 55, Tier 2 from age 62. New hires are Tier 2. As Tier 1 faculty leave, the pool shrinks and eligibility comes later in a career.

Replacement hiring need vs budgeted hires

Exits P10–P90Exits P50 (retire + separate)Hires at this budgetHires needed to hold the 2023 student–faculty ratio (P50)

Exits are the replacement need at constant headcount. The dashed line is exits plus the yearly change in the faculty count needed to keep the 2023 student–faculty ratio under the selected enrollment scenario. Under flat enrollment it equals exits. A hiring line above it means the faculty count is growing faster than enrollment.

Ratio by discipline group (index, 2023 = 1.00)

P10–P90P50

Discipline groups are 2-digit CIP families from IPEDS Completions 2022-23. No public source counts faculty by discipline, so faculty are split in proportion to the completions-weighted mix and hiring keeps that split. Every group therefore starts at 1.00. Above 1 means more students per faculty member than in 2023.

Pipeline flows (P50 per year)

Tenure = promotions from pre-tenure to tenured associate. Pre-tenure exits include denials. Each P50 is computed separately, so the columns are not additive.

Grey dots: 18 Big Ten main campuses (2024-25 membership), with the selected institution highlighted. UIC and UIS are not Big Ten members and are shown as a highlighted dot against the same peer set for context only.

Annual transition matrix at t0

State-level probabilities from Fall 2023 to Fall 2024 under the literature defaults with no incentive. Each row is weighted by the synthetic Fall 2023 composition. Rows sum to 1, and RET and SEP are absorbing. Inside the model, each age × years-in-rank × tier cell has its own row.
